extName.message: Crumble: Auto-Delete Cookies on Tab Close
extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and on chrome://extensions. Max 75 characters.

extDescription.message: Deletes cookies and site data when you close a tab. Keep the sites you trust. Imports your Cookie AutoDelete lists.

commandCleanNow.description: Keyboard shortcut name on chrome://extensions/shortcuts. Runs a cleanup of sites not open in a tab and not kept.

ruleErrorEmpty.message: Type a site, for example example.com, *.example.com or /regex/.
ruleErrorEmpty.description: Shown when a rule entry is empty.

ruleErrorRegexEmpty.message: "$PATTERN$" is an empty regular expression. Write a pattern between the slashes.
ruleErrorRegexEmpty.description: Shown when a rule is written as // with nothing between the slashes.

ruleErrorRegexUnclosed.message: "$PATTERN$" starts with / but does not end with /. Regular expressions are written between two slashes, for example /example\.(com|net)/.
ruleErrorRegexUnclosed.description: Shown when a rule starts with a slash but has no closing slash.

ruleErrorRegexTooLong.message: "$PATTERN$" is longer than 200 characters. Shorten the regular expression.
ruleErrorRegexTooLong.description: Shown when a regex rule is longer than 200 characters.

ruleErrorRegexUnsafe.message: "$PATTERN$" could take too long to check against long site names. Use at most two *, + or {n,} repeats, and do not repeat a group that already repeats or has |.
ruleErrorRegexUnsafe.description: Shown when a regex could cause catastrophic backtracking: nested repetition such as (a+)+, a repeated alternation such as (a|b)+, or more than two unbounded repeats.

ruleErrorRegexUnterminatedClass.message: "$PATTERN$" has a [ without a closing ]. Close the character class.

ruleErrorRegexUnterminatedGroup.message: "$PATTERN$" has a ( without a closing ). Close the group.

ruleErrorRegexUnmatchedParen.message: "$PATTERN$" has a ) without an opening (. Remove it or add the (.

ruleErrorRegexNothingToRepeat.message: "$PATTERN$" has a *, + or ? with nothing before it to repeat. Put a character or group before it.
ruleErrorRegexNothingToRepeat.description: Invalid regex: quantifier with nothing to repeat.

ruleErrorRegexRangeOrder.message: "$PATTERN$" has a range written backwards, such as z-a. Write the lower character first.
ruleErrorRegexRangeOrder.description: Invalid regex: range out of order in character class.

ruleErrorRegexTrailingBackslash.message: "$PATTERN$" ends with a single \. Remove it or escape it as \\.
ruleErrorRegexTrailingBackslash.description: Invalid regex: backslash at end of pattern.

ruleErrorRegexQuantifierOrder.message: "$PATTERN$" has a repeat count written backwards, such as {3,1}. Write the smaller number first.
ruleErrorRegexQuantifierOrder.description: Invalid regex: numbers out of order in {} quantifier.

ruleErrorRegexOther.message: "$PATTERN$" is not a valid regular expression ($DETAIL$). Check the pattern between the slashes.
ruleErrorRegexOther.description: Invalid regex, any other reason. DETAIL is the browser's own description of the problem.

productName.description: Product name, small, at the top of the popup.

popupSettings.description: Popup link that opens the settings page.

statusKept.description: Popup status: the current site is on the Keep list.

statusKeptUntilRestart.description: Popup status: the current site is on the Keep until restart list.

statusWillBeCleaned.message: Will be cleaned after you close it.
statusWillBeCleaned.description: Popup status: the current site is not kept.

statusNotWebsiteTitle.description: Popup heading on browser pages, PDFs and other non-web pages.

statusNotWebsite.message: Crumble only cleans websites, so there is nothing to do on this page.
statusNotWebsite.description: Popup status on non-web pages, under the heading 'Not a website'.

cookieCountSentenceOne.description: Popup: cookie count for the site, partitioned cookies included.

cookieCountSentenceOther.description: Popup: cookie count for the site, partitioned cookies included.

actionKeep.description: Popup button: add the current site to the Keep list.

actionKeepUntilRestart.description: Popup button: add the current site to the Keep until restart list.

actionRemoveFromList.description: Popup button: remove the current site's rule.

actionCleanSiteNow.description: Popup button: delete this site's cookies and site data now.

actionEditRule.description: Popup link: open this site's rule in settings.

setupUnfinished.message: Setup isn't finished, so nothing is cleaned automatically.
setupUnfinished.description: Popup line shown instead of the automatic cleaning switch until setup is done.

actionFinishSetup.description: Popup link to the welcome page.

actionCleanNow.description: Button: clean sites that are not open and not kept.

actionCleanIncludingOpen.description: Button: clean every site that is not kept, even open ones. Asks first.

confirmCleanIncludingOpenOne.message: Delete cookies and site data for $P1$ site, including sites open in tabs? This can't be undone after 2 minutes.

confirmCleanIncludingOpenOther.message: Delete cookies and site data for $P1$ sites, including sites open in tabs? This can't be undone after 2 minutes.

confirmNothingToClean.message: There is nothing to clean. Every site with data is kept.
confirmNothingToClean.description: Shown instead of the confirmation when nothing would be deleted.

actionConfirmCleanIncludingOpen.description: Confirm button for cleaning open tabs.

actionCancel.description: Button that closes a confirmation without changing anything.

lastCleanup.description: Popup: last cleanup. $1 = '14 sites', $2 = '212 cookies', $3 = '2 minutes ago'.

lastCleanupNothing.message: Last cleanup $P1$ had nothing to clean.
lastCleanupNothing.description: Popup: last cleanup removed nothing. $1 = '2 minutes ago'.

lastCleanupJustNow.description: Popup: result of a cleanup the user just ran.

noticeNothingCleaned.message: Nothing to clean. Kept and open sites were left alone.
noticeNothingCleaned.description: Popup: a manual cleanup found nothing to remove.

actionUndoCleanup.description: Popup link: restore the cookies deleted by the last cleanup.

undoHint.message: Undo restores cookies only. Site data can't be restored.
undoHint.description: Popup hint under the undo link.

undoRestoredOne.message: Restored $P1$ cookie. Site data can't be restored.

undoRestoredOther.message: Restored $P1$ cookies. Site data can't be restored.

undoExpired.message: Undo is no longer available. Deleted cookies are kept for 2 minutes only.
undoExpired.description: Popup: undo after the window closed.

actionDetails.description: Popup link: open the cleanup log.

progressCleaning.description: Popup: progress of a large cleanup.

ratingAsk.message: If Crumble is useful to you, a rating in the Chrome Web Store helps other people find it.
ratingAsk.description: One-time rating request in the popup.

actionNotNow.description: Dismisses an offer without doing anything.

notifyNothingCleaned.message: Nothing to clean. Kept and open sites were left alone.
notifyNothingCleaned.description: Notification after a manual cleanup that removed nothing.

announceSaved.description: Screen reader announcement after a setting is saved.

listsNote.message: Keep: never cleaned automatically. Keep until restart: kept until the browser next starts, then cleaned. A site on both lists is kept.
listsNote.description: Explanation at the top of Lists.

addRulePlaceholder.description: Placeholder for the add-rule field. Patterns are code.

addRuleHelp.message: example.com matches it and www.example.com. *.example.com also matches every subdomain. * matches anything. /pattern/ is a regular expression. Separate several with commas.

addRuleListLabel.description: Label for the list chooser next to the add field.

actionAddRules.description: Adds the typed patterns as rules.

searchRulesLabel.description: Label for the rule search field.

searchRulesPlaceholder.description: Placeholder for the rule search field.

filterAll.description: Filter: show rules on both lists.

columnStatus.description: Hidden column header for the status mark.

columnActions.description: Hidden column header for row actions.

selectRule.description: Checkbox label for a rule. $1 = pattern.

editRuleLabel.description: Accessible name of a row's Edit link.

deleteRuleLabel.description: Accessible name of a row's Delete link.

cookiesOnly.description: Rule summary: keeps only the named cookies. $1 = names.

siteDataKeepsAll.description: Rule summary: keeps all site data.

siteDataCleans.description: Rule summary: cleans these site data types. $1 = list of types.

noRulesYet.message: No rules yet. Add a site above, or use Keep in the popup on a site you want to stay logged in to.
noRulesYet.description: Empty state of the rule table.

actionImportRules.description: Opens a file chooser for a rules file.

actionExportRules.description: Saves the rules as a JSON file.

siteDataKeep.description: Rule option for a site data type.

siteDataClean.description: Rule option for a site data type.

noteLabel.description: Rule note field: free text for the user's own reference.

confirmDeleteRulesBody.message: Sites these rules protect will be cleaned like any other site from the next cleanup.

importSummary.message: $P1$ to add, $P2$ to replace, $P3$ that can't be imported. Nothing changes until you import.

importContainersOne.message: The file has $P1$ rule from Firefox container lists, which Chrome doesn't have.

importContainersOther.message: The file has $P1$ rules from Firefox container lists, which Chrome doesn't have.

importContainersMerge.message: Add container rules to the main lists

importWillReplace.message: These rules already exist and will be replaced:

importSkipUnknownList.message: An entry on an unknown list ($P1$). Only WHITE (Keep) and GREY (Keep until restart) lists from Cookie AutoDelete files are supported.
importSkipUnknownList.description: Import skip reason. Mentions the original's list names, which is allowed in the importer.

importSkipIpRange.message: "$P1$" is an IP address range. Crumble doesn't support ranges; add the individual addresses instead.

importErrorTooLarge.message: The file is larger than 1 MB. Choose a rules export file from Crumble or Cookie AutoDelete.

importErrorNotJson.message: The file isn't valid JSON. Choose a rules export file from Crumble or Cookie AutoDelete.

importErrorWrongShape.message: The file isn't a rules export. Choose a file exported from Crumble or from Cookie AutoDelete's expressions export.

importErrorTooManyRules.message: The file has more than 10,000 rules. Split it into smaller files and import them one at a time.

importErrorEmpty.message: The file is empty. Choose a rules export file from Crumble or Cookie AutoDelete.

cleaningNote.message: A site is cleaned shortly after its last tab closes, unless it is on a list.
cleaningNote.description: Explanation at the top of Cleaning.

setting_autoClean_help.message: Clean sites after you close them. When off, nothing is cleaned until you click Clean now.

setting_delay_help.message: Time to reopen a tab you closed by accident. Short delays can take up to 30 seconds.
setting_delay_help.description: Setting explanation. The 30-second note is required by the PRD.

delayOutOfRange.message: The delay must be a whole number from 1 to 3600 seconds. The previous value is kept.

setting_cleanOnDomainChange.message: Clean when a tab moves to another site

setting_cleanOnDomainChange_help.message: Cleans the site you left in that tab after the delay. Coming back before then cancels it, so logins that pass through another site keep working.

setting_cleanDiscardedTabs_help.message: Tabs Chrome has unloaded to save memory don't count as open.

setting_cleanOnStartup_help.message: Cleans everything not on the Keep list and not open, including Keep until restart sites.

setting_cleanOpenTabsOnStartup_help.message: Also cleans sites in tabs the browser restores when it starts.

setting_reloadAfterStartupClean.message: Reload restored tabs after the startup clean

setting_reloadAfterStartupClean_help.message: Reloads each restored tab once, so pages stop using data that was just removed.

setting_keepEmbeddedOnKeptSites.message: Keep embedded cookies on kept sites

setting_keepEmbeddedOnKeptSites_help.message: Cookies that embedded content (videos, widgets) set on a kept site are kept with it.

incognitoAllowed.message: Crumble is allowed in incognito and cleans incognito cookies with the same rules. Chrome also deletes all incognito data when the last incognito window closes.

incognitoNotAllowed.message: Crumble doesn't run in incognito. To allow it, open chrome://extensions, choose Details under Crumble and turn on Allow in Incognito. Chrome deletes all incognito data when the last incognito window closes anyway.

siteDataEmbeddedNote.message: Data that embedded content (videos, widgets) stores on a site is kept or cleaned together with that site.

siteData_localStorage_help.message: Small amounts of data sites save in your browser.

siteData_indexedDB_help.message: Larger databases sites keep in your browser, often for offline use.

siteData_cacheStorage_help.message: Files sites store for offline use and faster loading.

siteData_serviceWorkers_help.message: Background scripts sites install, for offline pages and notifications.

siteData_httpCache_help.message: Copies of pages and images. Clearing it makes sites load slower the next time.

offerClearTitleOne.message: Clear existing $P2$ for $P1$ site that isn't kept?
offerClearTitleOne.description: One-time offer after turning a type on. $2 = type name.

offerClearTitleOther.message: Clear existing $P2$ for $P1$ sites that aren't kept?
offerClearTitleOther.description: One-time offer after turning a type on. $2 = type name.

offerClearBody.message: This covers sites visited since Crumble was installed. Open sites are left alone. This can't be undone.

logNote.message: The last 50 cleanups, with why each site was kept or cleaned. Cookie values are never stored here.
logNote.description: Explanation at the top of Log.

logSiteCookiesOne.description: Log: cookies cleaned for a site.

logSiteCookiesOther.description: Log: cookies cleaned for a site.

logSiteData.description: Log: site data types cleaned for a site, after the cookie count.

logFailedCookie.message: Cookie $P1$ on $P2$ is still there after two attempts.

logFailedSiteData.message: Site data for $P1$ couldn't be cleared.

confirmClearLogBody.message: This removes the record of past cleanups. It doesn't restore anything.

display_badge.message: Cookie count on the toolbar icon

display_badge_help.message: Shows how many cookies the current site has, embedded ones included.

display_iconByList.message: Show the site's list in the toolbar icon

display_iconByList_help.message: Full square: kept. Half square: kept until restart. Empty square: will be cleaned.

display_notifyAuto_help.message: A short notification each time sites are cleaned on their own.

display_notifyManual_help.message: A short notification after Clean now and Clean this site now.

display_contextMenus_help.message: Adds Keep this site, Keep this site until restart and Clean this site now to the page and toolbar menus.

shortcutHelp.message: There is no shortcut until you choose one in Chrome's shortcut settings.

aboutPrivacyText.message: Crumble collects nothing and sends nothing. It has no account, no analytics and no servers; your rules and log stay in this browser.

aboutReportText.message: Opens a prefilled report with your browser version and settings, but no sites, rules or cookie data. You see and edit everything before sending.

reportCopyText.message: The project's issue page isn't set up yet. Copy this report and send it to the developer.
reportCopyText.description: Shown while the repository URL is a placeholder.

reportWhatHappened.description: Report field for the user's description.

aboutLicenceText.message: Crumble is open source under the MIT licence. It is an independent project, not affiliated with Cookie AutoDelete, and contains none of its code.

welcomeLine1.message: Crumble deletes cookies and site data shortly after you close a site's last tab.

welcomeLine2.message: Sites you choose to keep stay logged in.

welcomeLine3.message: Nothing is cleaned until you finish these three steps, and nothing leaves your browser.

setupStep1Title.message: Sites to keep you logged in

setupStep1Help.message: Ticked sites go on the Keep list and are never cleaned automatically. You can change this any time.

setupNoOpenSites.message: No websites are open in other tabs.

actionAddSite.description: Setup: add the typed site to the ticked list.

actionKeepSelectedOther.description: Setup step one button. $1 may be 0.

setupStep2Help.message: Import the expressions file you exported from Cookie AutoDelete. Its whitelist becomes Keep and its greylist becomes Keep until restart.
setupStep2Help.description: Setup step two explanation. The importer may name the original's lists.

actionContinue.description: Setup step two button after importing.

setupStep3Help.message: Automatic cleaning starts now and needs no restart. Manual mode cleans only when you click Clean now.

setupFinishedAutomatic.message: Automatic cleaning is on. Sites you haven't kept are cleaned shortly after you close them.

setupFinishedManual.message: Setup is done. Nothing is cleaned until you click Clean now in the toolbar popup.

setupFinishedHelp.message: Use the Crumble icon in the toolbar to keep a site or clean now. You can close this tab.

timeJustNow.description: Relative time for the last few seconds, as in 'Cleaned 3 sites, 4 cookies, just now.'

actionSkipKeep.description: Setup step one button when no site is ticked.

setupStep1None.message: No sites added. You can keep sites later from the toolbar popup.
setupStep1None.description: Setup step one, done with nothing ticked.

ruleSiteDataLabel.description: Accessible name of a rule's site data choice. $1 = type name.
